# Reveal Unifies Enterprise eDiscovery from Legal Hold Through Production

September 22, 2026

3 min

_Connected Reveal Hold, Onna and Logikcull offering gives corporate legal teams best-in-class technology across the discovery lifecycle, with Reveal AI providing intelligence across the stack_

**CHICAGO (Sept. 22, 2026) –** [Reveal](https://www.revealdata.com/), the provider of integrated AI-native platforms spanning the dispute resolution lifecycle, today announced the availability of its unified corporate eDiscovery suite, combining Reveal Hold, Onna and Logikcull across legal hold, preservation, collection, early case assessment, review and production.

The suite gives corporate legal teams purpose-built technology at every stage of the dispute resolution lifecycle without the cost or hassle of juggling multiple vendors. Outsourcing discovery or running complex enterprise software gets expensive fast, especially for in-house teams without a dedicated eDiscovery staff. Reveal's approach flips that: cull data through targeted collection and ECA before it ever hits review, then manage every stage in-house through interfaces built for legal teams and not IT departments. Reveal Hold, Onna and Logikcull provide a unified path from the moment a matter begins through final production.

"Corporate legal teams get stuck choosing between patching together point solutions or buying a platform that claims to do everything and does nothing particularly well, then managing the gaps between systems either way," said Eric Harmon, CEO of Reveal. "Our approach is to bring together exceptional products, not replace them with one generic application. We unified a suite where Reveal Hold, Onna and Logikcull support a streamlined workflow, so teams get the depth they need at each stage without the overhead of multiple vendor relationships and broken handoffs."

Each product handles a distinct phase of discovery. Reveal Hold manages legal hold and preservation, giving legal teams control over custodians, notices and potentially relevant information from the outset of a matter. Onna provides targeted collection and management across modern enterprise data sources, including Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Zoom, Salesforce, ChatGPT and Gemini. Logikcull takes teams through processing, culling, early case assessment, search, review and production in an automated, self-service environment.

Reveal has also deepened the integration between the three products. Many of Onna's data sources now feed directly into Reveal Hold's preservation and collection workflows. Targeted collections from Onna move into Logikcull with context, metadata and file relationships intact.

[Reveal AI](https://www.revealdata.com/product/reveal-ai), the company's agentic AI suite, will extend across the stack beginning in 2027. Its agentic workflow orchestration interface will coordinate work across Reveal Hold, Onna, Logikcull and Reveal Enterprise, giving legal teams the ability to direct work in plain language from hold and collection through review and production. Reveal AI already includes dedicated capabilities for fact-finding and analysis, document review and it’s starting to roll out agentic case development.

The unified suite is available now. **Preferred pricing is available to organizations that purchase the suite through Dec. 31, 2026.** For more information, visit [logikcull.com/product/corporate-suite](https://www.logikcull.com/product/corporate-suite).

###

**About Reveal**

Reveal is a leading AI-powered platform for eDiscovery, document review, legal hold and investigations. Its best-in-class suite of products includes Logikcull, Onna, Reveal Hold, Reveal Enterprise, and Brainspace. Reveal's software combines technology and human guidance to transform structured and unstructured data into actionable insight, helping law firms, corporations, government agencies, and service providers uncover useful information faster. For more, visit revealdata.com.
